'''Leria''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who lived during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. She worked in the [[Shining Star cantina]] on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]].
